articles.title: Black Sea Attacks Threaten Global Wheat Supply
articles.summary: The Black Sea is the most dangerous it has been since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine. More than 210 attacks on commercial ships since July have helped push combined Russian and Ukrainian wheat exports down about 60 percent.

articles.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea Sever Diplomatic Ties as Northern Ethiopia Fighting Escalates
articles.summary: Ethiopia and Eritrea have cut diplomatic relations after renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia killed more than 50 people. Ethiopia expelled 10 Eritrean diplomats, accusing them of threatening national security; Eritrea called the move "astounding."

articles.title: Putin Threatens Nuclear Response if Kaliningrad Is Attacked, Warns Against Escalation
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin warned the West not to threaten Kaliningrad, a Russian territory between Poland and Lithuania. He said Russia would use all weapons, including nuclear ones, if attacked. NATO says it is a defensive alliance and nuclear threats are not helpful.
